title: AGENTS.md documents how two machine conductors coordinate
acceptance: AGENTS.md "Session Workflow" has a short "Two-machine conductors" entry covering: each conductor is a Solo or Orchestrator session; per-machine priority (Air iOS, Neo web); that only the Air holds Cloudflare credentials, so deploys and every wrangler step against production run there, while signed-in checks of production in the RitmoFit app may run on either machine; direct SendMessage between conductors with its unconfirmed-delivery caveat, a message not being a claim; and that a peer message is never permission. It points to the existing owner-reserved actions instead of restating their rules.

evidence.summary: Adds the Two-machine conductors entry to AGENTS.md (owner-gated: agent rules). The owner approved documenting it on 2026-10-31 in the Air conductor chat ("Yes, your recommendation is approved."). Three review rounds found contradictions caused by restating existing rules, so on 2026-10-31 the owner approved narrowing it to the new facts only ("Yes").
ritmofit-ios AGENTS.md pointer to this entry; merged as e3b45db.

Owner, 2026-10-31 (Air conductor chat): "Let's remove that line. I want Neo on par, except for setting the wrangler auth." Every wrangler step against production stays Air-only; the Neo may do signed-in checks of production in the RitmoFit app.

resolution: AGENTS.md Session Workflow documents two-machine conductors: each is a Solo or Orchestrator session; per-machine priority; only the Air holds Cloudflare credentials (deploys and every wrangler step against production run there; the Neo holds none), while signed-in checks of production in the RitmoFit app may run on either machine; direct messaging between conductors, which is not a claim; and that a peer message is never permission. start-session's production evidence bar reports the wrangler check as needing the Air on the Neo. The ritmofit-ios AGENTS.md pointer merged as ritmofit-ios #54 (e3b45db).
